system.description: When you enter a room ready to make a scene, roll 2d6 and add +1 for each person in the room with whom you've been intimate (max +4).

success.value:
Anyone you've been intimate with is surprised, frightened, or confused.

You've seized control of the room; take +1 ongoing as long as you keep attention on yourself and don't let anyone stand in your way.

partial.value: Anyone you've been intimate with is surprised, frightened, or confused.

failure.label: Miss
failure.value: They don't give you the reaction you wanted; mark a condition and choose to either blurt out a secret or pour out your emotions for all to see.
